properties.description: Five independent lanes in one pipeline. Base = correct links; V1-V4 each change ONE link. Run with pFailAt = none / A / B / C and compare the lanes.

activities.name: Base A
activities.description: Lane Base: Correct setup

activities.name: Base B
activities.description: Lane Base: Correct setup

activities.name: Base C
activities.description: Lane Base: Correct setup

activities.name: Base Web
activities.description: Lane Base: failure email

body.value:
{"ReceipentTo":"@{pipeline().parameters.pMailTo}","ReceipentCC":"@{pipeline().parameters.pMailCc}","SenderFrom":"@{pipeline().parameters.pMailFrom}","MailSubject":"@{pipeline().Pipeline} - Base lane - FAILURE (pFailAt=@{pipeline().parameters.pFailAt})","MailBody":"Lane: Base (Correct setup)
Run ID: @{pipeline().RunId}
Error: @{replace(replace(concat(coalesce(activity('Base A')?.error?.message, ''), coalesce(activity('Base B')?.error?.message, ''), coalesce(activity('Base C')?.error?.message, '')), '\', '\\'), '"', '\"')}"}

activities.name: Base Fail
activities.description: Lane Base: keep the run Failed

message.value: @concat('Base lane failed: ', concat(coalesce(activity('Base A')?.error?.message, ''), coalesce(activity('Base B')?.error?.message, ''), coalesce(activity('Base C')?.error?.message, '')))
